data.job_title: Senior Engineer, Engineering Software R&D and Tech Support
data.skills:
•	Proficient in Web Technologies, Full Stack Development, C/C++/Visual C++/C#, numerical analysis, data structures, structured program design, and their applications to solving engineering problems
•	Proficient in developing UI/GUI using Web Technologies/Visual C++/C#/Python (desirable)
•	Should have good verbal and written communication skills in English
•	Self-motivated with strong work ethic
•	Strong computer skills and Willingness to travel
data.eligibility_information:
•	Qualification: Ph. D. (Research) in Mechanical/Civil/Structures
•	Skills: Sound understanding of mechanics (structural, solid and fluid mechanics)
•	Experience in Oil & Gas, Power, Process industries and/or aircraft & aerospace industries (desirable)
•	Prior experience in Design & Engineering of piping, tubing & ducting systems (desirable)
data.additional_information:
Job Title & Description

As Senior Engineer, Engineering Software R&D and Tech Support, your responsibilities will be:

• Design and develop engineering software solutions for piping, tubing, ducting, and structural applications.
• Develop and implement mathematical models for statics and dynamics, including interactions with fluid, soil and support structures.
• Create, optimize, and integrate algorithms into engineering software products.
• Collaborate closely with the R&D team to design and deliver innovative, industry-leading software solutions.

• Conduct product presentations and demonstrations to prospective clients.
• Provide timely and effective responses to modeling and engineering queries from software users worldwide.
• Perform verification and validation of new features and enhancements prior to software releases.
• Support the preparation, revision, and publication of software manuals, user guides and training tutorials.

• Provide technical expertise and support to the marketing team for product brochures, technical content and marketing materials.
• Represent the company at seminars, workshops, conferences and trade exhibitions.
• Author and present technical papers and articles for industry journals, magazines and professional publications.
• Undertake additional technical, operational, and project-related responsibilities as required.
